# Welcoming Stefan Sathianathen to Infinite


We are excited to announce that Stefan Sathianathen has joined Infinite as our Founding Member of Technical Staff, helping to lead payments platform engineering.


By[Nikhil Srinivasan](https://infinite.net/company/about) , Founder & CEO


·


April 1, 2026


·


1 min read


Team


We’re thrilled to welcome Stefan Sathianathen as our Founding Member of Technical Staff, who will help lead payments platform engineering.


Stefan is an industry leader in payments platform and product engineering, and brings a rare blend of fintech platform and product leadership.


Having spent the last four and a half years building platforms and products from the ground up at Adyen, Stefan brings a combination of frontline financial services and platform experience that aligns perfectly with what we are building here at Infinite.


At Infinite, our core platform is an embedded infrastructure layer within our customers’ product experiences. Stefan’s expertise reinforces that layer and accelerates our mission to build the best stablecoin experience for global commerce.


Excited to have you on board, Stefan!
